title: Actual exterior coefficients of a fixed negative Koszul pure-tensor boundary
statement: Let C be a small site with commutative ring sheaf O, A a commutative ring in the same universe, rho:A→End(O) a ring homomorphism, a:Fin r→A, and s:Fin r→sections(O) with rho(a_i)=ringedKoszulScalar O s_i. For a fixed n, integer q, and subset I with q=-card I, the canonical map ringedNegativeKoszulBasis O r s n I q followed by the actual negative Koszul differential is the sum, over L with q+1=-card L, of rho(exteriorKoszulCoefficient r (a_i^(n+1)) q I L) followed by ringedNegativeKoszulBasis O r s n L (q+1). Every basis inclusion is the existing explicit construction; no coordinate family, transition, duality or normalization is asserted.

proof.text: Apply the proved signed erased-index formula for the canonical negative basis. It gives the coefficient (-1)^(number of earlier selected indices) times a_i^(n+1), precomposed through rho, in the I.erase i coordinate, including the empty list. This supplies the negative boundary without a choice of coordinates.

source.place: Tags 0622 and 0664, ordered Koszul generators and the graded Leibniz rule; algebraization.tex, Tag 0A0E, lemma-derived-completion-koszul, finite free duality.

proof.text: Apply the exterior contraction formula to the increasing wedge on I. Omitting its ith vector leaves the increasing wedge on I.erase i; its position equals the number of earlier selected indices. The dual coordinate at L is one exactly when I.erase i=L, and zero otherwise. Hence the actual exteriorKoszulCoefficient is the identical signed erased-index sum. The ring homomorphism preserves sums, signs and powers, so substituting this identity in the preceding boundary expansion proves the displayed equality. For r=0 the negative complex is O[0] and the boundary is zero; empty index sets, zero rings and empty sites obey the same formulas.

lean.statement:
theorem ringedNegativeKoszulBasis_exterior_d
    {C : Type w} [SmallCategory C] {T : GrothendieckTopology C}
    (O : Sheaf T CommRingCat.{w}) {A : Type w} [CommRing A]
    (ρ : A →+* End (SheafOfModules.unit
      ((sheafCompose T (forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)).obj O)))
    (r : ℕ) (a : Fin r → A)
    (s : Fin r → (O.obj ⋙ forget CommRingCat).sections)
    (hρ : ∀ i, ρ (a i) = ringedKoszulScalar O (s i))
    (n : ℕ) (q : ℤ) (I : exteriorKoszulIndex r q) :
    ringedNegativeKoszulBasis O r s n I.1 q ≫
        (ringedNegativeKoszul O r s n).d q (q + 1) =
      ∑ L : exteriorKoszulIndex r (q + 1),
        ρ (exteriorKoszulCoefficient r (fun i ↦ a i ^ (n + 1)) q I L) ≫
          ringedNegativeKoszulBasis O r s n L.1 (q + 1)
